name: IKEA KALLAX shelving unit, 77x42 cm (two cubes side by side; floor or wall)

sources.what: product page (article 903.015.55; W 76.5 x D 39 x H 41 cm, max load 13 kg per shelf / 25 kg on top)

overallDimsMm.note: x=width, y=depth, z=height as stood horizontally; from the product page. Same unit can be stood on end as 42x77.

parts.name: long panel (top/bottom)
parts.material: board-on-frame (particleboard/fibreboard skins, honeycomb fill), foil/paint finish
parts.notes: Thickness ~38-39 mm is the common community figure for KALLAX outer panels (not IKEA-published). One long panel receives the divider's dowels.

parts.name: end panel
parts.notes: Fits between the long panels: 410 - 2x38 ~= 335 mm (derived). Joined end-on with connector screws through the long panels.

parts.name: divider
parts.notes: Thin vertical centre divider, located by 2 long dowels at each edge. Thickness ~15-16 mm from community measurements; opening ~335 mm square derived (765 = 2x38 + 2x~337 + 15).

hardware.size: connector screw, countersunk head with hex socket, coarse thread (IKEA 104321 / 104322), long (~90-100 mm, estimated)
hardware.notes: 2 per corner: driven through each long panel into the end-panel ends (steps 1, 3, 5). Driven with the included crank key.

hardware.size: long fluted wood dowel (IKEA 101339), approx 8x~60 mm (estimated)
hardware.notes: 2 at each edge of the divider (steps 2 and 4).
Fix the 2 plastic wall brackets inside the unit (step 6).
Inside top corner, wall mounting / anti-tip.
Screwed to the wall; brackets hook onto them (step 9). Wall screws and plugs NOT included.
Tool, included. Flat and Phillips screwdrivers, pencil and level shown as required tools.

joins.notes: Butt joint, 2 connector screws per corner through the face of the long panel into the end panel's end. No cam locks in this edition.
2 dowels per edge; divider is clamped between the long panels by the corner screws, not separately fastened.

assembly.stepsSource: official instructions AA-2731182-2, numbered steps 1-9 on pages 11-19 (pages 2-7 multilingual tip-over warnings, 8 tools/handling, 9-10 parts list)
order: 1: first end panel to the first long panel (2 connector screws)
2: divider dowels into that long panel, divider pushed on (2 dowels)
4: dowels on the divider's free edge (2 dowels)
5: second long panel onto ends and divider (4 connector screws)
6: wall brackets inside the unit (2x2 short screws) - optional wall-hung use
7: hold unit level against the wall, mark bracket holes
9: hook unit onto keyhole plates, adjust, clip covers on

confidence: high for overall dims (765x390x410), loads, part count (5 panels), hardware classes and counts (8x 104321/104322, 4x 101339 dowels, 4x 100372, 2x 115753, 2x 103693, 2x covers, crank key 100001) and the 9-step order - read from the IKEA page and the instruction drawings. medium for panel thicknesses (~38 outer, ~15 divider; community figures, consistent with the overall width). low for screw/dowel lengths (estimated).
notes: This current edition uses long connector screws plus dowels, not cam locks. The 77x42 unit is a 2-cube unit (the 42x77 orientation in the request is the same SKU stood on end). Structural assembly is steps 1-5; steps 6-9 are wall mounting.
